title: 第3章 不良人第4章 文考 城外女尸案
content_zh:
不良人府衙。
姜峰蹲在府衙前面的街边，三两口将食盒的长寿面吃了个干净，随便在身上的长袍擦了擦手，放下食盒后，便往府衙的方向走去。
景国不良人，掌刑狱，从事侦察、逮捕、审问等活动，也参与收集情报，探查军情，策反敌将等工作。
它不属于朝廷六部，虽是武职，但不属于军事系统，隶属于皇室。
同时，不良人也肩负着督查百官的职责。
多少贪官污吏都是因为不良人而锒铛入狱。
因此，无论是在官场还是民间，不良人都是凶名赫赫的存在，甚至能让小儿止啼。
而今日，姜峰来此不为报案。
他是来应招的。
大景文风盛行，凭他肚子里的存货，加上这几年读的圣贤书，只要参加科考，拿个秀才应该不难，咬咬牙努努力，中个举人什么的，也不是没有可能。
然而两个月前发生的一件事，却让他开始改变内心的想法。
他爹，还有姨娘，妹妹，全都失踪了。
犹记得两个月前，老爹写信托人送到书院，说妹妹病了，他跟姨娘带着妹妹姜川去雍州访寻名医，为此还花了钱，选择跟着一支商队同往，路上也算有个照应。
可一个多月前却传来噩耗，商队途经鹰嘴岭时，在路上遭遇不测。
先是遇见了山贼，商队的护卫不敌，死伤惨重。
众人不得已四散逃窜，恰好又碰到了百年不遇的大雨，导致山体滑坡，逃散的许多人因此而失踪，生死不明。
姜峰的家人便是如此。
姜峰得知消息后，能求的人都求了，书院的师长，刺史衙门，节度使衙门，不良人府衙，恳请他们帮忙找人，可结果……无人能帮！
于是他独自骑着快马赶去鹰嘴岭，在鹰嘴岭不眠不休找了十天，可茫茫山林，任他如何寻找，也寻不到家人的一丝踪迹。
那时候，姜峰才改变自己的想法。

大景崇尚文道，可最无力的恰恰是书生。
因此，他要加入不良人，他要自己去查家人的行踪。
加入不良人很难，但他并非没有办法。
……
“此乃不良人衙门，闲人不得靠近！”
府衙门口负责站岗的不良人见到姜峰靠近，手上连忙握着刀柄，口头上发出警告，眼神直勾勾的盯着姜峰，眸中杀意闪烁。
姜峰神色淡定，不卑不亢的说道：“这位大人，我是来应招的。”
站岗的不良人闻言，微微一怔：“来应招的？就你？”
他目光上下打量了一番姜峰，穿的这么寒酸，一看就是清贫的读书人，也好意思说自己是来应招不良人？
真以为他们不良人是救济馆吗？
“去去去，也不撒泡尿照照你自己的样子，就你这样还想加入我们不良人，我劝你还是回家洗洗睡吧，也许梦里还有机会。”
他讥讽道。
姜峰也不恼，而是从怀里取出一封书信：“这是家师为我开的介绍信，还请大人替我转交。”
递出信件的同时，他还偷偷将一粒碎银子，塞到对方的手中。
那是他卖掉老爹平时打铁用的锤子，火炉，钳子，换来的碎银，也是身上仅有的一点钱财。
站岗的不良人不动声色的将银子藏好，旋即接过信件，嘴里丢下一句“等着”
，便往府衙里面悠悠走去。
姜峰站在门口等了好一会儿，那位不良人才走了出来，目光好奇的打量着他。
“你就是姜峰？那个江州书院的第一才子？”
姜峰淡淡的点了点头：“我是姜峰，至于第一才子的名号，不过是他人吹捧出来罢了。”

不良人目光明显收起了轻蔑之色，认真的看了姜峰一眼，道：“进去吧，统领大人在里面等你。”
他看着姜峰进入府衙的背影，嘴里奇怪的嘀咕一声：“真是奇了怪了，一个颇有名气的读书人，居然跑来应招我们不良人？”
不是他们不良人不好，而是他们经常受到那些读书人的贬低，嘲讽，鄙视。
在读书人眼中，他们这些不良人都是一群粗鄙的武夫，动刀子还行，可要说治理天下，还不是得靠那些读书人？
对于这种说法，身为不良人的赵小乙同样深以为然。
content_en:
Bad people's government offices.
Jiang Feng squatted on the street in front of the government office, ate the longevity noodles from the food box in a few mouthfuls, wiped his hands casually on his robe, put down the food box, and walked in the direction of the government office.
A bad person in Jingguo, in charge of the prison, engaged in reconnaissance, arrests, interrogations and other activities. He also participated in collecting intelligence, exploring military situations, and instigating rebellion against enemy generals.
It does not belong to the six departments of the imperial court. Although it is a military position, it does not belong to the military system and is subordinate to the royal family.
At the same time, bad people also shoulder the responsibility of supervising all officials.
How many corrupt officials have been imprisoned because they are bad people.
Therefore, whether in the officialdom or among the people, bad people have a reputation for being evil and can even make children stop crying.
Today, Jiang Feng came here not to report the crime.
He's here to answer the call.
The literary style of Dajing is prevalent. With the stock in his stomach and the books on sages he has read in the past few years, it should not be difficult to become a scholar as long as he takes the scientific examination. If he grits his teeth and works hard, it is not impossible to be a scholar or something.
However, something happened two months ago that made him change his mind.
His father, aunt, and sister were all missing.
I still remember that two months ago, my father sent a letter to the academy saying that his sister was sick. He and his aunt took his sister Jiang Chuan to Yongzhou to visit a famous doctor. They spent money on it and chose to go with a caravan, so they could be cared for on the way.
But more than a month ago, bad news came. When the caravan passed through Yingzui Ridge, it encountered an accident on the road.
First, they encountered bandits. The caravan's guards were defeated and suffered heavy casualties.
Everyone had no choice but to flee in all directions, but it happened to encounter a heavy rain that had not happened in a century, causing landslides. Many people who fled were missing as a result, and their lives and deaths were unknown.
This is the case with Jiang Feng's family.
After Jiang Feng learned the news, he asked everyone he could, including the teachers of the academy, the governor's office, the governor's office, and the bad people's government office. He begged them to help find someone, but in the end... no one could help!
So he rode a fast horse to Yingzui Ridge alone, where he searched for ten days without rest, but no matter how he searched in the vast mountains and forests, he could not find any trace of his family.
It was then that Jiang Feng changed his mind.
Da Jing advocates literature and art, but the most powerless people are precisely the scholars.
Therefore, he wants to join the bad guys and he wants to find out the whereabouts of his family himself.
It's hard to join the bad guys, but it's not impossible for him to do it.
…
"This is a bad person's yamen, no idlers are allowed to come near it!"
The bad guy standing guard at the gate of the government office saw Jiang Feng approaching. He quickly held the handle of the knife in his hand and issued a verbal warning. He stared at Jiang Feng with murderous intent in his eyes.
Jiang Feng looked calm and said in a neither humble nor condescending manner: "My lord, I am here to answer the call."
When the bad guy on guard heard this, he was slightly startled: "You're here to answer the call? Are you the only one?"
He looked Jiang Feng up and down. He was dressed so shabbily, and he looked like a poor scholar. How dare he say that he was here to recruit bad people?
Do you really think they are bad people working in a soup kitchen?
"Go, go, don't pee and look like yourself. If you still want to join us bad guys, I advise you to go home and wash yourself. Maybe there will be a chance in your dream."
he sarcastically said.
Jiang Feng was not annoyed, but took out a letter from his arms: "This is the letter of introduction written by my master for me. Please forward it to me."
While handing over the letter, he secretly thrust a piece of silver into the other party's hand.
That was the scraps of silver he got from selling his father's hammer, stove, and pliers that he usually used for blacksmithing. It was also the only money he had.
The bad guy on guard hid the money calmly, took the letter immediately, and said "Waiting"
, then walked leisurely to the government office.
Jiang Feng stood at the door and waited for a long time. The bad guy came out and looked at him curiously.
"Are you Jiang Feng? The number one talent in Jiangzhou Academy?"
Jiang Feng nodded lightlyHe nodded and said, "I am Jiang Feng. As for the title of the most talented person, it was just praised by others."
The bad guy's eyes obviously dropped his contempt, and he looked at Jiang Feng seriously and said, "Go in, the commander is waiting for you inside."
He looked at Jiang Feng's back as he entered the government office and murmured strangely: "It's really weird. A well-known scholar actually came to recruit us bad guys?"
It’s not that they are bad people, it’s that they are often belittled, ridiculed, and despised by those who read.
In the eyes of scholars, these bad people are just a group of vulgar warriors. It's okay to use a knife, but when it comes to governing the world, don't we have to rely on those scholars?
Zhao Xiaoyi, a bad person, also believes in this statement.
